title: Government whistleblowers claim UFO retrievals

tellings.quote: their government whistleblowers coming out of saying that they've retrieved UFOs one of whom I've had on my show and like you know it's kind of hard to park poke holes in his story

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that government whistleblowers have come forward claiming the US has recovered UFOs. He notes that one of them has been on his show and that he finds it hard to poke holes in that man's story, which, if true, would mean the government holds crashed or captured craft.
